prd_sections: 3.3 快捷下单采用当前交易对已有杠杆配置
contract_checks: Official symbol-scoped bracket response is object; array variant accepted only for exactly one matching symbol
Bracket initialLeverage is market maximum, not proof of the current account exposure allowance
Bracket integer notionals stay exact; decimal strings retain precision; floating JSON values rejected
Position configuration includes zero-sized BOTH or coherent LONG + SHORT rows
POST accepts form body; exact query bytes signed using Aster EIP712 chainId 1666
Connected address is both user and signer; no new wallet, agent or API key
Symbol-scoped leverage affects both hedge sides; no per-side parameter
HTTP acknowledgement is not a verified final setting; explicit separately signed GET determines observed leverage
Documented errors -2027 maximum exposure, -2028 insufficient margin, -4028 invalid leverage mapped to safe reasons
reference_boundary: Reference uses its own Hip3 backend/context; its signing and wire protocol are not used as Aster authority.
implementation_boundaries: Explicit context read requires two signatures; no read on page entry
UI bound is min(documented 125, max bracket initialLeverage); actual exposure/margin validation stays at Aster
Context expires after 30 seconds and new observed account events invalidate it; wallet approval must still be current at send boundary
Target is an integer differing from queried current setting; confirmation freezes wallet/symbol/previous/target
POST never automatically retried; unknown outcome blocks new submissions and exposes GET-only recheck
After submission, portfolio/risk/ADL/order snapshots are marked historical without automatic additional signatures
Verification is a time-labelled setting snapshot; no position/risk fields are fabricated from it
Live authorization acceptance and physical signed-in values are unverified; tests use controlled local responses
